messages.en:
Hello, and thank you for
calling the Hit Or Miss
Fortune Hotline!
{06 00 00 01 02}
messages.et:
Tere ja aitäh helistamast
Pihta-või-Mööda
ennustusliinile!
{06 00 00 01 02}

messages.en:
A rival approaches!{01 00 00 14 00} Make
sure you don't weave any
tangled webs for yourself.
messages.et:
Rivaal läheneb!{01 00 00 14 00} Vaata,
et sa ei koo endale
segast võrku.

messages.en:
Sunday dates are made for
walks in gardens...but you
may not see the flowers.
messages.et:
Pühapäevased kohtingud on
aiajalutuskäikudeks...aga
sa ei pruugi lilli näha.

messages.en:
Use your brain! If it sounds
too good, it is! You'll
regret it later...or sooner!
messages.et:
Kasuta pead! Kui kõlab
liiga hästi, siis nii ongi!
Kahetsed hiljem...või varem!

messages.en:
Watch your cash flow.{01 00 00 14 00} Maybe
you should wait a month
before buying that tiara.
messages.et:
Jälgi rahavoogu.{01 00 00 14 00} Äkki
peaksid ootama kuu aega,
enne kui tiaara ostad.

messages.en:
Stay that wound up, and
you're likely to pop!{01 00 00 14 00} Try
to relax a little.

You're in for a confusing
day. Stuff that should be
easy won't.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}and vice versa.
messages.et:
Sind ootab segane päev.
Asjad, mis peaksid olema
lihtsad, pole{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.ja vastupidi.

messages.en:
Remember, it's not a done
deal{01 00 00 05 00} 'til the dealin's
done.
messages.et:
Pea meeles: tehing pole
tehtud{01 00 00 05 00} enne, kui see on
tehtud.

messages.en:
Finding the perfect partner
is all about good
salesmanship!{01 00 00 14 00} Sell yourself!

Face west by southwest and
bite into a veggie dog to
enhance your monetary luck!
messages.et:
Pööra nägu lääne ja edela
vahele ja hammusta taimset
hotdogi rahaõnne jaoks!

messages.en:
Don't panic! Just breathe in
pink, breathe out blue. {01 00 00 14 00}It's
the recipe for relaxation.
messages.et:
Ära paanitse! Hinga sisse
roosat, välja sinist. {01 00 00 14 00}See on
lõõgastumise retsept.

messages.en:
Be bold!{01 00 00 14 00} The bluebird of
happiness is pecking at
your window, so let him in!
messages.et:
Ole julge!{01 00 00 14 00} Õnne sinilind
koputab su aknale, nii et
lase ta sisse!

messages.en:
Your best defense against
your worst enemy lies deep
within you.{01 00 00 14 00} If you're lucky.
messages.et:
Parim kaitse su halvima
vaenlase vastu peitub sinus
sügaval.{01 00 00 14 00} Kui sul veab.

messages.en:
Your luck's taking a turn
for the worse.{01 00 00 14 00} Best to stay
inside.{01 00 00 05 00} And probably in bed.
messages.et:
Su õnn pöördub
halvemaks.{01 00 00 14 00} Parem püsida
toas.{01 00 00 05 00} Ja ilmselt voodis.

messages.en:
Your tough facade is
starting to crack.{01 00 00 0a 00} You
should take a nap.
messages.et:
Su kõva fassaad hakkab
pragunema.{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa peaksid
uinaku tegema.

messages.en:
You are in control of your
own future.{01 01 00} Don't tell the
boss I said that, OK?
messages.et:
Sina juhid oma tulevikku.
{01 01 00} Ära ütle ülemusele,
et ma nii ütlesin, eks?

messages.en:
Walk the path less traveled,
but watch your feet.{01 00 00 14 00} It's
a bit muddy.

A group outing is your
chance to bring that
special someone closer.
messages.et:
Rühmaväljasõit on sinu
võimalus tuua see eriline
inimene endale lähemale.

messages.en:
You may not be looking for
trouble, {01 00 00 05 00}but trouble's
definitely looking for you.
messages.et:
Sina ei pruugi pahandust
otsida, {01 00 00 05 00}aga pahandus
otsib kindlasti sind.

Pea meeles: vaata enne
tänava ületamist mõlemale
poole.{01 00 00 14 00} Usu meid.

messages.en:
I predict that, this coming
winter, sweaters will come
back into fashion.
messages.et:
Ennustan, et tuleval talvel
tulevad kampsunid
uuesti moodi.

messages.en:
In the very near future,{01 00 00 05 00}
you will eat a meal.
messages.et:
Väga lähitulevikus{01 00 00 05 00}
sööd sa söögikorra.

messages.en:
The next time you go to a
carnival, avoid cotton
candy. {01 00 00 14 00}You'll thank us.

Don't waste life chasing
your tail. {01 00 00 14 00}The stars tell us
you'll never catch it.
messages.et:
Ära raiska elu oma saba
taga ajades. {01 00 00 14 00}Tähed ütlevad,
et sa ei saa seda kunagi.

messages.en:
A scandal will soon strike
whose repercussions will be
both tragic and hilarious.
messages.et:
Varsti puhkeb skandaal,
mille tagajärjed on nii
traagilised kui naljakad.

messages.en:
The planets are right for
love!{01 00 00 14 00} You, however, are not,
so give it a rest.
messages.et:
Planeedid on armastuseks
soodsad!{01 00 00 14 00} Sina aga mitte,
nii et jäta see rahule.

messages.en:
The time is ripe for you to
make your move!{01 00 00 14 00} What that
move is remains unclear.
messages.et:
Aeg on küps, et käik
teha!{01 00 00 14 00} Milline see käik
on, jääb ebaselgeks.

messages.en:
Even the simplest word will
resonate deeply,{01 00 00 14 00} so watch
what you say!
messages.et:
Isegi lihtsaim sõna
kõlab sügavalt,{01 00 00 14 00} nii et
vaata, mida sa ütled!

messages.en:
Mars is entering the house
of Taurus,{01 00 00 14 00} but we're not
sure what that means.
messages.et:
Marss siseneb Sõnni
majja,{01 00 00 14 00} aga me pole
kindlad, mida see tähendab.

Pettekujutlused sünnitavad
pettekujutlusi.{01 00 00 14 00} See müts
ei sobi su riietusega.

messages.en:
Something will throw you
off your schedule.{01 00 00 14 00} Just sit
back and enjoy the ride.
messages.et:
Miski viib su ajakava
segi.{01 00 00 14 00} Lihtsalt naudi
seda sõitu.

messages.en:
You think you want a
change, but you really
don't.{01 00 00 14 00} Take a closer look.
messages.et:
Sa arvad, et tahad
muutust, aga tegelikult
ei taha.{01 00 00 14 00} Vaata lähemalt.

messages.en:
Every day is stressful.{01 00 00 14 00} Go
to the beach and shout at
the sea.{01 00 00 05 00} Just let it out!

Try as you might, you will
not succeed.{01 00 00 14 00} But you
still have to try.
messages.et:
Ükskõik kui palju pingutad,
sul ei õnnestu.{01 00 00 14 00} Aga sa
pead ikkagi proovima.

messages.en:
The stars tell you to watch
for unexpected riches,{01 00 00 05 00} but
that seems rather obvious.
messages.et:
Tähed käsivad jälgida
ootamatuid rikkusi,{01 00 00 05 00} aga
see tundub üsna ilmne.

messages.en:
While playing a sport, you
will see yourself in a new
light!{01 00 00 0a 00} But it won't last.

A close friend will do or
say a terrible thing.{01 00 00 14 00} You
will forgive {01 00 00 05 00}but not forget.
messages.et:
Lähedane sõber teeb või
ütleb midagi kohutavat.{01 00 00 14 00} Sa
annad andeks,{01 00 00 05 00} ei unusta.

messages.en:
Your time has come!{01 00 00 05 00} Dimples
are making a comeback!
messages.et:
Su aeg on käes!{01 00 00 05 00} Naerulohud
tulevad tagasi moodi!

messages.en:
The stars tell me that your
shoes need replacing.{01 00 00 14 00} Look
into that, will you?
